Fuel is clad in Zircaloy, a zirconium alloy that barely absorbs neutrons.
# Zirconium
- Zircon Dust, Coal Coke and 200 mB of Chlorine in the Chemical Reactor make Zirconium Tetrachloride.
- Reduced with 200 mB of Hydrogen at high heat (an electrically heated charge: 160 FE/t) it gives Zirconium Dust and Hydrochloric Acid.
- Smelt the dust into Zirconium Ingots.

# Zircaloy
In the Arcforge Furnace, four Zirconium Ingots with one Nickel Ingot and a little coke make four Zircaloy Ingots. The Metal Press with a Rod Die draws each into a Zircaloy Tube.
